'''Randy Bautista Mind What Leia Has Learned''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Randy Bautista]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls61.htm Mind What Leia Has Learned], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228060027/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls61.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
